name: expense-webapp

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Claims, approvals, team queues and payroll export data.

dependencies.name: receipt-agent
dependencies.description: Reads an uploaded receipt and pre-fills the claim form.

dependencies.name: thunder-auth
dependencies.description: Sign-in for employees, managers and finance.

description: The single-page app every actor uses: employees submit and track claims, managers review and decide on their team's claims, and finance exports approved claims to payroll. Role-gated screens sharing one shell. Does not store claim data itself — all of it lives behind expense-api.
